## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm test` (in `plugin/` and in `app/`)
- [ ] `node scripts/build-client.mjs --check` (in `plugin/`)
- [ ] `npm run lint` (in `plugin/`)
- [ ] Smoke test, for changes to `plugin/index.js`, `plugin/src/host/` or `engine/`
- [ ] Screenshot attached, for interface changes

## Checklist

- [ ] One issue, one subject.
- [ ] `src/client/` changed → `npm run build` ran and `client.js` is committed.
- [ ] No keys, tokens or personal data, also in screenshots.
- [ ] All new text is English.
- [ ] No AI tool as author or `Co-authored-by`.
